Add these engineering rules to acme/api with the Syllabus CLI (0.4.0 or later).

From fabricahq/public-rules:
- The whole Testing group (practices/testing), including rules the library adds to it later
- The rule techs/go/return-errors, without the rest of its group
- The rule practices/testing/keep-tests-independent, forked from version 1.0.0 as a local rule I can edit

From fabricahq/code-rules-test-library:
- The rule techs/go/close-bodies, forked from version 1.0.0 as a local rule I can edit

Run:
# From the root of acme/api

# If .syllabus/config.yaml has schemaVersion: 1,
# rewrite it as version 2 first: https://code-rules.fabricahq.com/reference/configuration/#version-1-configuration

# acme/api already imports fabricahq/public-rules as team.
# In .syllabus/config.yaml, add to sources.team.rules.include:
#   - practices/testing/*
#   - techs/go/return-errors

syllabus project sync

syllabus project add rule practices/testing/keep-tests-independent \
  --from team@1.0.0 \
  --reason 'We maintain our own version of this rule.'

syllabus project add rule techs/go/close-bodies \
  --from https://github.com/fabricahq/code-rules-test-library.git@1.0.0

syllabus project build

Then make sure AGENTS.md tells agents to read .syllabus/generated/RULES.md. The rules move to newer versions only when someone runs syllabus project update and confirms.
